name: jarvis-extensions
description: Jarvis 开放平台：扩展仓库、SDK、契约与文档。

scripts.check:extensions: for d in extensions/*/ templates/*/; do tsc -p "$d/tsconfig.json" --noEmit || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: npm run check:sdk && npm run check:extensions && npm run build && npm run validate && npm run registry:check
